skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate and edit AI images through the inference.sh CLI using FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and related image models.
skill.summary: Generate, edit, upscale, and stitch AI images with inference.sh image models.
skill.author: skillssh

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and fenced command examples being classified as Ruby backtick execution. One low network finding remains for mutable raw GitHub installation guidance, and one semantic medium finding covers the broad Bash(infsh *) permission for external image generation.

remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed tools to specific infsh subcommands if supported, and require confirmation before sending private prompts or images.
Document that prompts, source images, and image URLs may be sent to inference.sh and upstream model providers.
Link to a versioned release or pinned install document instead of a raw main-branch URL.

semantic_findings.title: Broad External CLI Permission
semantic_findings.description: The skill front matter grants Bash(infsh *) access. This enables calls to the inference.sh CLI, which can send prompts, image URLs, and generated assets to an external service.

content.value_statement: Creating image prompts and model commands can be slow and inconsistent. This skill guides image generation, editing, upscaling, and model choice through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh CLI examples for supported image models.
Guides text-to-image generation with FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve models.
Provides examples for image upscaling, stitching, and prompt-based editing.
Lists available inference.sh image apps by category.
Links users to related inference.sh image skills and documentation.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Sends prompts, image URLs, and related inputs to external services.
Does not include local model weights or offline image generation.
Model quality, pricing, speed, and availability depend on inference.sh providers.

use_cases.title: Create Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate studio-style product images and concept mockups from short creative briefs.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Create social, web, and advertising visuals with consistent style and aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Test model choices and CLI-driven image workflows before building automation.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a square AI image of [subject] in [style]. Use a practical model and explain the chosen settings.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Best Model
prompt_templates.prompt: I need an image for [goal]. Compare suitable inference.sh image models and recommend one with aspect ratio and prompt guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Edit or Upscale an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this image URL for [editing goal]. Recommend the best image editing or upscaling flow and describe the expected result.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Visual Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a consistent visual set for [campaign]. Define model choices, prompt themes, aspect ratios, and review steps for each asset.

output_examples.input: Create a studio product photo of a matte black water bottle.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a high-quality image model, refines the prompt, recommends square framing, and prepares a generation workflow.

output_examples.input: Make a wide cyberpunk city banner for a landing page.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a wide aspect ratio, chooses a cinematic model, and adds lighting, composition, and mood details.

output_examples.input: Upscale this product render for a presentation.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies an upscaling workflow, explains input requirements, and notes that the source image URL is sent externally.

best_practices: Confirm model pricing and account status before generating many images.
Avoid sending confidential images, private prompts, or customer data to external services.
Use clear subject, style, composition, aspect ratio, and quality requirements in each prompt.
anti_patterns: Expecting offline generation without the inference.sh CLI and account access.
Using vague prompts and relying on the model to infer brand, layout, and size.
Uploading sensitive images or private URLs without approval and retention review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps generate, edit, upscale, and stitch AI images through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account for model execution.

faq.question: Can it run without internet access?
faq.answer: No. The skill depends on external inference.sh services and provider-hosted image models.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for image editing, upscaling, and stitching when supported by the selected model.

faq.question: What data should I avoid using?
faq.answer: Avoid confidential prompts, unreleased product images, customer data, and private image URLs unless approved.
